review_kind: Codex AI read-only source and saved-stack investigation

tools/tutorials/capture_home_live.py.note: Trigger reviewed from recorded Git blob; current CH driver differs.

latest_read_only_comparison.finding: Preferences implementation unchanged; console change is painting-palette lookup; ambient changes are Spaceout rendering work. No measured assertion about whether latest source removes this Apply stall.

observations.meaning: The nominal 100ms GUI timer was delayed. Four aggregate paint increments between endpoints do not show continuous repaint during the missing interval.
Confirms Preferences Apply, not the Save button. The sampled Python line is not a duration profile or proof that font-scale retrieval caused the delay.
Cold compiler/plugin discovery was active concurrently. Potential interpreter/GIL interference is a hypothesis; no measured cost or causal fraction is available.
Original immutable gate passes while preserving app-freeze observations. This report neither overwrites it nor accepts the freeze.

settings_sharing_constraint.finding: _apply invokes _save inside _in_one_store. The same shared QSettings instance is served to this GUI thread throughout apply_preferences_to_app, including ConsolePanel._zoomed_font_pt/get_font_scale. sync is deferred until the block exits. This stack cannot justify blaming repeated QSettings creation or one INI write per getter/setter on this path. Settings value lookup, platform font lookup and wrapper calls still repeat, but their cost is unmeasured.

candidate_repeated_work.finding: Every preference application enumerates all live consoles, re-queries system fixed-font point size and font scale, then reapplies point size to every stdout block and QLabel. Neither console setter nor stdout-block setter guards an unchanged point size. Each stdout setter sets widget/document fonts, sets its stylesheet, merges paragraph format across the whole document, clears height cache and updates geometry. Work scales with retained console entries/document content, including hidden panels.
candidate_repeated_work.status: Concrete unconditional work from source; contribution to this saved stall not measured.

candidate_repeated_work.finding: A one-effect Apply writes every dialog preference, broadcasts card rim updates, revisits live ambient widgets/dialogs/button roles, and executes Spaceout runtime-controls/restart/rebuild checks. Revert repeats appearance/runtime propagation. Existing equality guards in GUI-scale, ambient field-effect setters and backdrop build signatures prevent some unchanged work; do not infer every backdrop was rebuilt.
candidate_repeated_work.status: Repeated traversal/dispatch confirmed; per-operation timing not measured.

candidate_repeated_work.finding: Style signature already skips identical global stylesheet recomposition, sliced Apply only rederives icons when scale changes, and unchanged GUI scale returns early. Save(close=True) takes unsliced application and always scans icon sizes, while Apply(close=False) retains the dialog and uses slices. Tests must keep these branches distinct.
candidate_repeated_work.status: Existing constraints; do not remove necessary initial application or real scale/theme changes.

focused_tests_Home_should_use.recommendation: Fresh isolated process/private store with real Spaceout field. First measured button action toggles Vortices and clicks PreferencesApply, before any baseline Apply/Revert or console font restyle. Record GUI heartbeat gaps and per-step profiles; verify preview and Revert restore all eight effects. Measure pending sliced work as well as click return.

Separately cover first Save button close=True and first Apply close=False; then unchanged and nonvisual saves, Vortices change, Apply again, Keep and Revert in the same process. Verify first application initializes newly created consoles/ambient widgets and does not get skipped by an application-wide cache. Existing entries at the right size should avoid needless document restyling on unchanged scale.

focused_tests_Home_should_use.case: Unchanged console zoom versus real size change
focused_tests_Home_should_use.recommendation: Populate shown and hidden ConsolePanels with multiple retained output blocks, paragraph content and labels. Spy on whole-document format/style/default-font/geometry work during unchanged-scale Apply. Then change global font scale and column text scale separately; every existing and newly created entry must receive the new effective size, including hidden consoles.

In separate CPU-only controlled runs, record first Apply while warm-scatter thread is compiling and after readiness. Capture thread-aware profiles/heartbeat gaps to test the contention hypothesis, without attributing improvement to font-scale lookup based on one stack.

Reuse repolish-budget, changed-scale console, live Spaceout field-effect Save and smooth Apply/Keep/Revert tests. The existing smooth test pre-applies preferences in its fixture and executes old baseline Apply/Revert first, warming the exact path before measuring new behavior; its relative speed assertions do not cover a cold first action.

limitations: One saved all-thread snapshot locates execution, not exclusive cost or causality.
The 0.606s sampler interval is not a measured duration of get_font_scale, console restyling or compiler work.
Aggregate paint counters in this legacy receipt do not identify widget-level responsiveness.
No profiler, GUI, GPU, recording or test was run; recommendations remain unmeasured.
Raw source, receipts, videos and gate results were not modified.
